# Pre-market brief, Tue 2026-10-27 (as of ~8:25 AM ET)

1. **Futures firm into FOMC (decision Wed 2 PM).** ~8:01 AM: S&P +0.27%, Nasdaq-100 +0.37%, Dow +0.25% ([Markets Insider](https://markets.businessinsider.com/premarket)); chips (NVDA, INTC, MRVL) higher pre ([TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262242150-us-ko-meta-spacex-nvda-intc-tradingkey)). Hold expected; big-tech earnings MSFT/GOOGL Wed, AMZN Thu ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2114432803248959935)).
2. **Macro tape:** WTI ~$101 (−0.7%), Brent ~$115 (−0.8%) ([Markets Insider](https://markets.businessinsider.com/premarket)); US 10y ~4.99%, BTC ~$79.6–79.8k, slightly lower ([FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/analysis/fed-rate-decision-warsh-faces-a-market-on-edge-as-bitcoin-sits-at-79k-gold-weakens-202610270742); [Exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/crypto/BTC)). Today: durable goods 8:30, Conf. Board confidence and new home sales 10:00.
3. **Earnings movers** ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/27/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-pypl-glw-ups-ko.html)): UPS +1.6% (beat, FY rev guide raised to ~$92.6B from $91.2B); GLW ~+3% (adj EPS $0.91 vs $0.88, rev $5.08B); RCL +4.4% (adj EPS $6.57 vs $6.38, FY guide raised); KO +0.3% (raised outlook, comp EPS ≥+11%); PYPL −1% (rev miss, profit guide raised); WHR −7% (loss vs profit est., guide cut). CLS +16% on beat-and-raise ([Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/trading-ideas/movers/26/10/62610414/why-celestica-shares-are-trading-higher-by-over-16-here-are-20-stocks-moving-premarket)), gap >5% so skip per lessons. HSBC −6% on miss ([TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262242150-us-ko-meta-spacex-nvda-intc-tradingkey)).
4. **Covered names:** NVDA investing $3B in META's up-to-$95B raise; NVDA +0.7%, META −0.3% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/27/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-pypl-glw-ups-ko.html)). TSLA ~+1% pre after +5.2% on Barclays upgrade ([Public](https://public.com/stocks/tsla/pre-market); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/26/tesla-spacex-merger-barclays.html)).
5. **Earnings next 10 days:** V, HOOD tonight; MSFT, GOOGL, NOW, TMUS Wed AMC; LLY, CAT BMO and AMZN, INTC, COIN, SBUX AMC Thu; XOM Fri; AAPL 11/2.

Signals: added WHR, HSBC avoids; airline avoids extended to 10/30 (Brent still ~$115).

## Swing ideas
- **UPS** long, med. Beat and raised FY revenue guide; small gap fits beat-and-raise lesson. Risk: parcel volume softness, fuel costs.
- **RCL** long, low. Beat and raised FY EPS. Risk: revenue slightly missed, some cost savings were timing; high oil.
- **GLW** long, low. Clean beat on AI optical demand. Risk: crowded AI-hardware tape into MSFT/GOOGL capex reads.
